metaDescription: Newfoundland vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Newfoundland boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: The Newfoundland core series (DA2PP / DHPP plus rabies per law) is plotted at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks in the table above so a giant puppy is covered as maternal antibodies fade.
At 100-150 lb (45-68 kg), Newfoundland visit logistics matter as much as antigens: book the 16-week appointment before class, daycare, or boarding asks for proof.
Bring hip dysplasia and elbow dysplasia into the Newfoundland exam-room conversation while you are already there for shots.
Rabies for a Newfoundland still follows local statute, and when the clinic allows you can pair it with the ≥16-week core finish, then photograph the certificate into PetClues the same day.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Newfoundland boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Newfoundland row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Newfoundland item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Newfoundland kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Newfoundland due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Newfoundland core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Newfoundland misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Newfoundland health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Newfoundland adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
